# tissue_mast_probe (Data Source)

A probe, by id or by name, for reading one someone made in the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tissue_mast_probe" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}

output "shop_probe_target" {
  value = data.tissue_mast_probe.shop.target
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The probe id.
- `name` (String) The probe name. It has to be unique to look it up this way.

### Read-Only

- `alert_source_id` (String) The alert source its pages go to, if it has one.
- `channel_id` (String) The same as `alert_source_id`, under the API's older name.
- `expect` (String) `up`, or `down` for a target that should not answer.
- `host` (String) The machine the target runs on, if the probe names one.
- `interval_secs` (Number)
- `kind` (String) `http`, `tcp`, `tls`, `dns`, `icmp` or `smtp`.
- `method` (String)
- `paused` (Boolean)
- `policy_id` (String) The policy its pages follow, if it has one.
- `state` (String) What the checks found as of the read, such as `down`; `pending` before the first check, `paused` while the probe is paused.
- `target` (String)
